groups.defect: isTeamAdminOrOwner joins isTeamAdmin and isTeamOwner with && instead of ||, so admins who are not owners are denied. Extra points to keep: any matching attendee can add guests (too permissive), and the 'you_do_not_have_permission' translation key is missing.
groups.rationale: All four report the same && vs || bug in the permission check. Two of them each add a different extra concern.

groups.defect: Guest emails are not lowercased, so the blacklist check and the existing-attendee dedupe are case-sensitive and can be bypassed. Extra points to keep: duplicates inside the submitted guest list are not removed server-side, and the isAttendee comparison is also case-sensitive.
groups.rationale: All four report the same case-sensitive comparison in the blacklist/dedupe filter. Some also add in-list deduplication or the isAttendee comparison.

groups.defect: sendAddGuestsEmails receives the raw guests list instead of uniqueGuests, so filtered-out emails get the wrong email. Also, updateCalendarAttendees runs after the DB write without error handling, so a calendar failure leaves guests saved while the request returns an error.
groups.rationale: s_c03cd3b4 reports both defects. s_d430022b shares the raw-guests defect and s_72a13bc3 shares the calendar-error defect, which links all three.
